title: Long-Term Health and Neurodevelopment in Children After Antenatal Exposure to Low-Dose Aspirin for the Prevention of Preeclampsia and Fetal Growth Restriction: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials

sections.abstract: <jats:p>(Abstracted from <jats:italic toggle="yes">Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol</jats:italic> 2021;267:213–220)</jats:p> <jats:p>Pregnant women with increased risk of preeclampsia are advised by international guidelines to take low-dose aspirin throughout their pregnancy. As this indicates that a substantial portion of fetuses experience exposure to aspirin, the question of long-term effects on child health is raised.</jats:p>
